items.title: Welcome to the course
items.body: Welcome! Lectures start on Tuesday. Tutorials start in week 2. Everything you need is on this page: the weeks and their activities, the evaluations, and the course's policies.

items.title: Assignment 1 is out
items.body: Assignment 1 is posted under Evaluations. It's due at the end of week 4.

items.title: Midterm room and time
items.body: The midterm is on Wednesday after Reading Week, 18:00 to 19:50. Bring your student card.
